text.text:
I burned $103 on integration tests today.

Here's how it happened:

Cursor added GPT-5.4. To try it, I had to enable MAX mode toggle.

Tested it. Switched back to my usual Opus 4.6.

The model changed. The MAX toggle didn't.

I assumed switching back to my previous model resets everything.
It doesn't. MAX mode is a separate, sticky toggle.

So every test run for the rest of the day was burning on-demand MAX credits.
Without me knowing.

Then I got this email from Cursor:

"You've used $103.00 in on-demand usage for your current cycle"

One forgotten toggle. $103.

UX takeaway: if enabling setting A requires setting B,
disabling A should reset B. Otherwise it's a trap.

Check your AI tool settings. Especially the ones you didn't touch today.

Have you ever been surprised by an AI bill?

#AI #SoftwareEngineering #Cursor #CostManagement
